cards.name: THE FOOL
cards.subtitle: The Reveler
cards.upright: Holy madness, uncalculated courage, stepping off the precipice into the radiant unknown, cracked carnival mask, rebirth from zero.
cards.inverted: Blind recklessness, refusing the call to mutate, wandering without anchor, heedless destruction of consecrated boundaries.
cards.scripture: He who protects his mask leaves his face in darkness. Step where the floor has not yet crystallized; the light shall catch your heels.

cards.name: THE MAGICIAN
cards.subtitle: The Prism Saint
cards.upright: Refraction of divine will into tangible power, mastery of the four elements, technical genius, ritual focus, active transmutation.
cards.inverted: Charlatanism, misdirected energy, burning out the ocular nerves with unshielded brilliance, deceit through hypnotic illusions.
cards.scripture: White light is sterile until it strikes the prism. Do not pray for unity; pray to be cut so you may cast color.

cards.name: THE HIGH PRIESTESS
cards.subtitle: The Veiled Oracle
cards.upright: Secret archives, deep intuition, silent knowing, communion across the veil, guardianship of forbidden codices, the unuttered vowel.
cards.inverted: Hidden secrets that rot the vessel, isolation, disconnection from mortal reality, cold indifference dressed as mysticism.
cards.scripture: Between the twin crystal pillars, nothing is spoken. What you hear is the hum of the stone remembering tomorrow.

cards.name: THE EMPRESS
cards.subtitle: The Crystal Mother
cards.upright: Sovereign fertility, abundant mineral growth, life born from cosmic radiation, nurturing creative power, sensory majesty.
cards.inverted: Smothering attachment, barren vanity, fungal overgrowth, creative stasis choked by excess luxury.
cards.scripture: Even in the vacuum of deep space, the crystal grows if watered with tears. You are her fruit; bloom or be mined.

cards.name: THE EMPEROR
cards.subtitle: The Ringmaster
cards.upright: Architect of the Procession, iron dominion, disciplined boundaries, civil order, protective authority, sovereign stability.
cards.inverted: Tyranny, brittle rigidity, fear of loss of control, an emperor reigning over a desert of pulverized glass.
cards.scripture: A circle drawn in blood is a cage; drawn in gold, it is a sanctum. Rule your carnival, or become a sideshow.

cards.name: THE HIEROPHANT
cards.subtitle: The Hierophant of Glyphs
cards.upright: Sacred lineage, lineage teachings, orthodox geometry, institutional wisdom, initiation into the Nine Threads.
cards.inverted: Dogmatism, hollow orthodoxy, corrupted priesthoods, persecution of the inspired heretic.
cards.scripture: The chisel does not argue with the granite. Trace the glyph as the ancients carved it, and the door shall unlock itself.

cards.name: THE LOVERS
cards.subtitle: The Twin Threads
cards.upright: Quantum entanglement of souls, divine choice, union of dualities, covenant sealed in crystal resin, sacred vulnerability.
cards.inverted: Codependency, severed vows, misalignment of core frequencies, indecision that splits the spirit.
cards.scripture: Two rays meeting at acute angles either fuse into a cutting beam or ignite the room to ashes.

cards.name: THE CHARIOT
cards.subtitle: The Siege Leviathan
cards.upright: Irresistible momentum, harnessing contradictory beasts, victory through disciplined willpower, unyielding armor.
cards.inverted: Runaway violence, catastrophic derailment, arrogance driving over sacred soil, loss of steering control.
cards.scripture: Yoke the black beast and the neon beast to the same axle. Give them no fodder save the horizon.

cards.name: STRENGTH
cards.subtitle: The Beast-Tamer
cards.upright: Mastery of primal mutation through compassion, inner resilience, fearlessness before the abyssal brute, gentle iron.
cards.inverted: Raw brutality, surrender to monstrous impulses, cowardice masquerading as peace, exhaustion of inner reserves.
cards.scripture: The monster does not obey the whip. It lays its horned head in your lap when it realizes your heart is harder than its teeth.

cards.name: THE HERMIT
cards.subtitle: The Glow-Touched Ascetic
cards.upright: Solitary pilgrimage, inner illumination, withdrawal from the noisy procession, shining a beacon for lost wanderers.
cards.inverted: Misanthropy, self-imposed exile in dark caves, bitterness toward the living, hoarding wisdom in silence.
cards.scripture: He who carries the lantern does not need the sun. Walk alone until your shadow begins to shine.

cards.name: WHEEL OF FORTUNE
cards.subtitle: The Vorathic Clock
cards.upright: Cosmic cycles, unavoidable destiny, sudden elevation, alignment with stellar mechanics, karmic harvest.
cards.inverted: Resisting the turn of time, clinging to expired seasons, bitter fatalism, bad timing through stubbornness.
cards.scripture: The cogs are cut from obsidian. You cannot grease them with tears. Ride the gear to the apex; prepare to descend.

cards.name: JUSTICE
cards.subtitle: The Justiciar
cards.upright: Flawless clarity, karma measured on diamond scales, objective truth, contracts honored, moral equilibrium.
cards.inverted: Hypocrisy, corruption of law, evasion of responsibility, biased judgments that sever the innocent.
cards.scripture: The blade cuts equally whether held by saint or assassin. Stand naked before the balance and tell no lies.

cards.name: THE HANGED MAN
cards.subtitle: The Refracted Martyr
cards.upright: Voluntary surrender, sacred pause, transfiguration through sacrifice, viewing the cosmos upside-down to find the truth.
cards.inverted: Pointless martyrdom, spiritual stalling, victimization complex, refusing to let go of what is dead.
cards.scripture: Hang suspended from the crystal tree until your blood runs into your crown. Only the upside-down eye sees heaven underfoot.

cards.name: DEATH
cards.subtitle: The Ouroboros
cards.upright: Radical termination, complete molt, the old forms shattered to feed the new bloom, liberating ending.
cards.inverted: Clinging to corpses, fear of death, slow decay without transformation, necrotic resistance to change.
cards.scripture: The serpent does not mourn its skin. It leaves it on the rock and walks away in fresh scales. Die cleanly.

cards.name: TEMPERANCE
cards.subtitle: The Alchemist of Light
cards.upright: Blending fire and abyssal water, spiritual moderation, synthesis of opposites, equilibrium, graceful patience.
cards.inverted: Extremism, turbulent imbalance, volatility, pouring wine into sand and water into oil.
cards.scripture: Pour the void into the beam. If you rush, the vessel shatters. If you hesitate, the liquid cools to stone.

cards.name: THE DEVIL
cards.subtitle: The Greater Daemon
cards.upright: Material obsession, addictive radiance, shadow contracts, voluntary enslavement to sensory bliss, confronting inner demons.
cards.inverted: Breaking the chains, shattering the false altar, emancipation from toxic pacts, sobriety after cosmic delirium.
cards.scripture: The chains are not made of iron; they are spun from your own unadmitted hungers. Look at your collar: you hold the key.

cards.name: THE TOWER
cards.subtitle: The Overload
cards.upright: Catastrophic breakthrough, sudden demolition of false foundations, lightning striking the spire, unavoidable liberation.
cards.inverted: Discarding warning signs, lingering in a crumbling structure, fear of collapse, delayed catastrophe.
cards.scripture: When the spire grows too tall for heaven, the lightning is not an enemy—it is an architect clearing the horizon.

cards.name: THE STAR
cards.subtitle: The Northstar
cards.upright: Serene inspiration, calm after catastrophe, divine guidance, pure crystal water pouring on barren soil, renewal.
cards.inverted: Despair, cynicism, lost navigation, overlooking blessings right before your feet.
cards.scripture: Look up. Across ten thousand void leagues, that one blue needle burns for you alone. Follow it home.

cards.name: THE MOON
cards.subtitle: The Sacred Abyss
cards.upright: Entering the deep unconscious, dreamwork, terrifying beauty, hallucinations of the deep sea, sacred terror.
cards.inverted: Deception, paralyzing paranoia, drowning in imaginary demons, losing grip on daylight reality.
cards.scripture: The ocean has no ceiling. Walk down the coral steps and do not breathe; the water will teach your lungs to burn.

cards.name: THE SUN
cards.subtitle: The Radiant Bloom
cards.upright: Full chromatic brilliance, unadulterated joy, victory in daylight, health, vitality, every color harmonized.
cards.inverted: Solar blindness, exhaustion from performative happiness, sunburn of the ego, superficial optimism.
cards.scripture: All nine colors meet here in blinding gold. Dance in the open courtyard; you are seen, and you are beautiful.

cards.name: JUDGEMENT
cards.subtitle: The Ascension
cards.upright: Cosmic summons, resurrection of the true self, forgiveness of past iterations, stepping onto the Fracture Table to ascend.
cards.inverted: Self-doubt, ignoring the horn of awakening, clinging to petty recriminations, fear of final evolution.
cards.scripture: The horn does not blow to condemn you; it blows to wake you from the nightmare of your smallness. Rise.

cards.name: THE WORLD
cards.subtitle: VORATH
cards.upright: Total wholeness, the dance of cosmic completion, integration of all Nine Threads, mastery, joyful belonging in the infinite universe.
cards.inverted: Unfinished business, near-misses, refusal to close the chapter, seeking validation outside the self.
cards.scripture: I am the serpent eating its tail, and the egg inside the serpent, and the hand holding the egg. All is finished; all begins.

cards.name: II of Chalices
cards.subtitle: The Harmonic Communion
cards.upright: Soul meeting, twin frequencies resonating, mutual consecration, partnership of equals.
cards.inverted: Asymmetric devotion, misunderstanding, emotional manipulation.

cards.name: III of Chalices
cards.subtitle: The Revelers' Toast
cards.upright: Carnival fellowship, sisterhood and brotherhood in the procession, shared feast, gratitude.
cards.inverted: Hedonistic escapism, cliquish gossip, burnout from endless revelry.

cards.name: IV of Chalices
cards.subtitle: The Sated Trance
cards.upright: Contemplation, apathy toward earthly offerings, searching within for a deeper nectar.
cards.inverted: Snubbing genuine blessings, chronic depression, breaking out of lethargy.

cards.name: V of Chalices
cards.subtitle: Spilled Elixir
cards.upright: Grief over lost vessels, mourning what broke, acknowledging sorrow while three cups still stand.
cards.inverted: Acceptance of grief, turning around to see what remains, emotional healing.

cards.name: VI of Chalices
cards.subtitle: Echoes of the Nursery
cards.upright: Sweet nostalgia, innocence of the first home, gifts from the past, karmic reunions.
cards.inverted: Trapped in childhood memories, outgrown bonds, romanticizing obsolete trauma.

cards.name: VII of Chalices
cards.subtitle: Visions of the Deep
cards.upright: Hallucinations of the abyss, multiple alluring pathways, spiritual mirages, limitless imagination.
cards.inverted: Dispel illusions, facing cold reality, picking the genuine jewel from the smoke.

cards.name: VIII of Chalices
cards.subtitle: The Pilgrimage Outward
cards.upright: Walking away from what no longer feeds the soul, leaving the cups behind to climb the mountain.
cards.inverted: Clinging to a dead circumstance out of fear, returning to the empty well.

cards.name: IX of Chalices
cards.subtitle: The Wellspring of Bliss
cards.upright: The wish fulfilled, deep satisfaction, contentment in body and spirit, private abundance.
cards.inverted: Smug arrogance, physical indulgence at expense of spiritual depth, empty wishes.

cards.name: X of Chalices
cards.subtitle: The Abyssal Haven
cards.upright: Radiant family concord, eternal love anchored in community, the sanctuary of peace realized.
cards.inverted: Fractured households, unrealistic expectations of harmony, domestic strife.

cards.name: Ace of Chalices
cards.subtitle: Fountain of the Abyss
cards.upright: Overflowing spiritual grace, awakening of deep psychic love, unconditional emotional genesis.
cards.inverted: Emotional depletion, blocked heart, shallow sentimentality.

cards.name: God of Chalices
cards.subtitle: The Sovereign of the Deep
cards.upright: Master of emotional storms, compassionate ruler, calm depth, spiritual elder guiding ships home.
cards.inverted: Emotional blackmail, repressed rage, cold emotional tyrant.

cards.name: Justiciar of Chalices
cards.subtitle: The Tide Justiciar
cards.upright: The romantic quester, poet-knight, pursuing holy visions, offering the cup of peace.
cards.inverted: Deceptive charmer, emotional instability, fleeing before commitment.

cards.name: Acolyte of Chalices
cards.subtitle: The Abyssal Acolyte
cards.upright: Intuitive messenger, poetic heart, receiving dreams from the deep sea, tender empathy.
cards.inverted: Emotional volatility, living in fantasy, moodiness, psychic vulnerability.

cards.name: Saint of Chalices
cards.subtitle: The Abyssal Saint
cards.upright: Mistress of empathy, seer of the deep tides, healing presence, holding space for all sorrow.
cards.inverted: Smothering melodrama, psychic boundary failure, projection of moods.

cards.name: II of Glyphs
cards.subtitle: The Balance of Matter
cards.upright: Juggling two priorities, adapting to fluctuating markets, graceful balance of resources, playful work.
cards.inverted: Financial overextension, dropping the ball, chaotic accounting.

cards.name: III of Glyphs
cards.subtitle: The Mason of Sigils
cards.upright: Master craftsmanship, collaboration on the sacred cathedral, skill recognized, exquisite workmanship.
cards.inverted: Poor quality, lack of team harmony, pride that refuses peer review.

cards.name: IV of Glyphs
cards.subtitle: The Hoarded Relic
cards.upright: Clinging to wealth, rigid security, hoarding resources out of scarcity fear, fortified castle.
cards.inverted: Financial generosity, opening the treasure chests, reckless spending.

cards.name: V of Glyphs
cards.subtitle: Exile from the Temple
cards.upright: Physical hardship, shivering in the cold void, financial poverty, overlooking the lit window of the temple.
cards.inverted: Recovery from ruin, welcome back into the warmth, end of financial isolation.

cards.name: VI of Glyphs
cards.subtitle: The Shared Resonance
cards.upright: Generous patron, balanced charity, giving and receiving in equal measure, investment in community.
cards.inverted: Strings-attached philanthropy, debt traps, subservience for coin.

cards.name: VII of Glyphs
cards.subtitle: Tending the Monoliths
cards.upright: Patient evaluation of the harvest, long-term investments maturing, pausing to check progress.
cards.inverted: Impatience, abandoning the crop before harvest, fruitless labor.

cards.name: VIII of Glyphs
cards.subtitle: The Apprentice's Chisel
cards.upright: Devoted apprenticeship, repetition for mastery, carving the glyph ten thousand times, noble labor.
cards.inverted: Careless shortcuts, burnout from repetitive strain, lack of ambition.

cards.name: IX of Glyphs
cards.subtitle: The Gilded Citadel
cards.upright: Material independence, exquisite self-reliance, solitary garden of luxuries, quiet refinement.
cards.inverted: Superficial opulence, isolation in a golden cage, financial fraud.

cards.name: X of Glyphs
cards.subtitle: Dynasty of the Stone
cards.upright: Generational legacy, ancestral wealth, enduring institutional stability, blessings passed to descendants.
cards.inverted: Family inheritance feuds, loss of dynasty reputation, brittle tradition.

cards.name: Ace of Glyphs
cards.subtitle: The First Inscription
cards.upright: Tangible material gift, seed of financial prosperity, grounded opportunity, touch of the divine in physical stone.
cards.inverted: Missed investment, squandered resources, greed that corrupts the seed.

cards.name: God of Glyphs
cards.subtitle: The Sovereign of Glyphs
cards.upright: Master builder, financial titan, commanding material reality, steadfast protector of the realm.
cards.inverted: Corrupt tycoon, evaluating human life in terms of gold, gluttonous miser.

cards.name: Justiciar of Glyphs
cards.subtitle: The Glyph Justiciar
cards.upright: Methodical worker, steady guardian, unwavering loyalty, finishing the project on time.
cards.inverted: Stubborn obstructionist, penny-pinching pedant, unmoving inertia.

cards.name: Acolyte of Glyphs
cards.subtitle: The Glyph Acolyte
cards.upright: Diligent student of nature, pragmatic seeker, respecting physical laws, grounded news of profit.
cards.inverted: Financial laziness, daydreaming without action, neglecting physical health.

cards.name: Saint of Glyphs
cards.subtitle: The Saint of Foundations
cards.upright: Earth mother, pragmatic abundance, nurturing physical sanctuary, grounded generosity.
cards.inverted: Smothering materialism, neglecting inner spirit for external status.

cards.name: II of Lasers
cards.subtitle: Crossed Wavelengths
cards.upright: Stalemate, blindfolded balance, refusing to look at difficult options, defensive truce.
cards.inverted: The blindfold falls, compulsory choice, breaking the cold war.

cards.name: III of Lasers
cards.subtitle: The Severed Core
cards.upright: Heart pierced by three beams, painful truth revealed, grief that clarifies, surgery of the soul.
cards.inverted: Healing the scar, refusing to dwell in betrayal, moving past heartbreak.

cards.name: IV of Lasers
cards.subtitle: The Cooldown Stasis
cards.upright: Mental rest, retreat into meditation chamber, cooling down overheated circuits, convalescence.
cards.inverted: Restlessness, returning to the battle too early, stagnant hibernation.

cards.name: V of Lasers
cards.subtitle: The Ruthless Vector
cards.upright: Pyrrhic victory, victory by dishonorable means, standing alone amid enemies, bitter triumph.
cards.inverted: Reconciling after pointless feuds, laying down weapons, regret over cruelty.

cards.name: VI of Lasers
cards.subtitle: Crossing the Beamway
cards.upright: Passage across dangerous waters to calmer shores, taking wisdom from battle, mental migration.
cards.inverted: Carrying baggage across borders, unfinished arguments, stormy crossing.

cards.name: VII of Lasers
cards.subtitle: The Stolen Frequency
cards.upright: Cunning strategy, stealth, escaping unnoticed, taking what is essential, covert action.
cards.inverted: Caught in deception, confessing secrets, self-deception, poorly planned schemes.

cards.name: VIII of Lasers
cards.subtitle: The Cage of Light
cards.upright: Trapped by imaginary laser bars, mental paralysis, self-limiting beliefs, helpless victimhood.
cards.inverted: Realizing the bars are light and can be stepped through, mental liberation.

cards.name: IX of Lasers
cards.subtitle: The Midnight Feedback
cards.upright: Night terrors, obsessive anxiety, feedback loop of guilt, agony of the awake mind at 3 AM.
cards.inverted: Dawn breaking, seeing fears were shadows, seeking professional counsel.

cards.name: X of Lasers
cards.subtitle: Total Overload
cards.upright: Rock bottom, every beam discharged into the back, end of an agonizing ordeal, cannot get worse.
cards.inverted: Rising from the slaughter, worst is finally behind you, miraculous survival.

cards.name: Ace of Lasers
cards.subtitle: The Coherent Beam
cards.upright: Pristine clarity, cutting through confusion with laser intellect, raw truth, absolute justice.
cards.inverted: Weaponized cruelty, cutting words that wound, intellectual tyranny.

cards.name: God of Lasers
cards.subtitle: The Sovereign of Lasers
cards.upright: Supreme commander of truth, analytical supremacy, just magistrate, clear intellectual vision.
cards.inverted: Ruthless authoritarian, emotional sterility, tyranny of logic over mercy.

cards.name: Justiciar of Lasers
cards.subtitle: The Laser Justiciar
cards.upright: Fierce champion of truth, dashing forward without hesitation, intellectual bravery, direct assault.
cards.inverted: Fanatical rage, charging blindly into ambushes, abrasive dogmatism.

cards.name: Acolyte of Lasers
cards.subtitle: The Beam Acolyte
cards.upright: Curious intellect, vigilant scout, sharp questions, whistleblower for truth, brisk thinker.
cards.inverted: Spying, sharp sarcastic tongue, paranoid accusations, gossip.

cards.name: Saint of Lasers
cards.subtitle: The Saint of Clarity
cards.upright: Piercing wisdom, no tolerance for falsehood, autonomous mind, sovereign honesty tempered by sorrow.
cards.inverted: Cruel cynicism, cold vindictiveness, bitter judgmental isolation.

cards.name: II of Crystals
cards.subtitle: The Twin Spires
cards.upright: Visionary planning, weighing two creative horizons, preparing to launch the expedition.
cards.inverted: Indecision, fear of leaving familiar shores, narrow horizons.

cards.name: III of Crystals
cards.subtitle: The Prismatic Triad
cards.upright: Ships returning with crystal cargo, expansion, enterprise flourishing, teamwork validated.
cards.inverted: Delays in arrival, disappointed expectations, isolated ambition.

cards.name: IV of Crystals
cards.subtitle: Sanctuary of Light
cards.upright: Homecoming celebration, consecrated community, rites of arrival, marital or warband concord.
cards.inverted: Tension beneath polite smiles, disruption of home rites, transient joy.

cards.name: V of Crystals
cards.subtitle: The Fracture Struggle
cards.upright: Creative friction, competition of egos, tournament of wills, sharpening against rivals.
cards.inverted: Malicious conflict, pointless infighting, litigation and chaos.

cards.name: VI of Crystals
cards.subtitle: The Radiant Triumph
cards.upright: Public victory, laurel crown of neon light, community acclaim, riding at the head of the procession.
cards.inverted: Fall from grace, arrogance before the fall, hollow applause.

cards.name: VII of Crystals
cards.subtitle: The Bastion of Geodes
cards.upright: Standing your ground against superior odds, defending the high spire, principled resistance.
cards.inverted: Overwhelmed by criticism, giving up the barricade, futile martyrdom.

cards.name: VIII of Crystals
cards.subtitle: Beams in Flight
cards.upright: Rapid movement, messages arriving swiftly, coherent flight, sudden acceleration.
cards.inverted: Miscommunication, delayed transmissions, hasty panic, colliding signals.

cards.name: IX of Crystals
cards.subtitle: The Vigil of Shards
cards.upright: The scarred veteran, standing one last watch, resilience born of surviving fracture.
cards.inverted: Paranoia, refusing to lower shields, defensive exhaustion.

cards.name: X of Crystals
cards.subtitle: The Weight of Brilliance
cards.upright: Bearing the heavy crystal burden, over-commitment, the fatigue of success, carrying the entire warband.
cards.inverted: Crushed under duty, needing to drop unnecessary stones, relief through surrender.

cards.name: Ace of Crystals
cards.subtitle: Seed of Refraction
cards.upright: Spark of divine will, sudden creative breakthrough, initiation of sacred passion.
cards.inverted: False start, fizzling excitement, exhaustion before inception.

cards.name: God of Crystals
cards.subtitle: The Sovereign of Crystals
cards.upright: Master visionary, inspired leader, turning visionary ideas into empire, benevolent monarch of flame.
cards.inverted: Despotic megalomania, unbending pride, burning the kingdom to warm his throne.

cards.name: Justiciar of Crystals
cards.subtitle: The Crystal Justiciar
cards.upright: Charging into adventure, fierce champion of the light, dynamic questing, fearless pursuit.
cards.inverted: Reckless impulsiveness, scorching the earth, arrogance without wisdom.

cards.name: Acolyte of Crystals
cards.subtitle: The Prism Acolyte
cards.upright: The eager student of light, bearer of brilliant tidings, boundless curiosity, child-like passion.
cards.inverted: Erratic tantrums, gossiping acolyte, scattering energy without focus.

cards.name: Saint of Crystals
cards.subtitle: The Luminous Saint
cards.upright: Sovereign charisma, creative vitality, fierce warmth, magnetizing loyalty through sheer radiance.
cards.inverted: Demanding jealous adoration, fiery temperament, domineering vanity.
